Oath & Action Brand Guide, Edition 06. Phase 0 review board, October 20, 2026. Design director. Diagnosis only: nothing on this board proposes a change.

Identity at small sizes

Every mark here is the V5 Polished vector master from the inline sprite, extracted to work/extract/v5-polished/sprite/. Each is rendered by Chromium at device scale 1 and shown at its true pixels, then enlarged with nearest-neighbour scaling so you can see what the screen draws. Measurements come from the outlines themselves (work/build/scripts/phase-0/identity_geometry.py) and from the rasters (identity_board.py). x means one cap height of the wordmark, 100 units.

Companion board: pillar marks and topic icons. Audit note: work/handoffs/phase-0/20261020_Design-Director-Audit.md.

Panels: 1 Spacing · 2 Ampersand weight · 3 Joins at small sizes · 4 Red edge contrast · 5 Clipped outlines · 6 The 16 px ampersand · 7 Lockmark pixel fit · 8 Stated minimums · 9 Full matrix

1. Letterspacing and kerning across O A T H & A C T I O N

The letters are stock Inter Tight 800 outlines. Spacing is the font's own advance widths with a uniform tracking of minus 2 percent of the em, plus the font's kerning on O to A, A to C (minus 3.8 percent) and A to T (minus 9.1 percent). C to T, T to H, T to I, I to O and O to N carry tracking only. The two hinge gaps are set by hand.

Blue bars mark the nearest ink-to-ink point of each pair. Under each pair: label, nearest gap in cap heights, then the area-based gap in grey (white area between the two outlines across the cap band, depth capped at 0.2x, divided by the cap height). The area-based figure tracks what the eye reads as spacing.

  • Left hinge, H to &: nearest gap 0.101x, area-based 0.198x. Right hinge, & to A: nearest gap 0.083x, area-based 0.261x. V5 states 0.10x on each side. The right side measures 0.083x at the baseline and reads about 32 percent more open, because the A's diagonal leaves a wedge of space above the tail.
  • I to O and O to N are the tightest pairs: 0.074x nearest, 0.149x area-based. A to T is the most open at 0.281x. The range is close to 2 to 1, so ACTION's right half reads denser than OATH.
  • T to H and T to I leave 0.053x between the bar and the stem: 0.79 px at 16 px tall and 1.18 px at 24 px.
  • Monogram: O to & nearest gap 0.136x, & to A 0.083x. Area-based 0.252x and 0.261x. The monogram is balanced by eye even though its two measured gaps differ.
  • Stacked: the ampersand is 1.318x the cap height, sits right of ACTION and straddles the line gap of 0.10x. The reading order becomes OATH ACTION &.

2. Ampersand weight against the capitals

The ampersand outline is the Lora Bold glyph, unmodified: all 120 coordinate pairs match the font embedded in V5, scaled by 0.14. V5 describes it as redrawn. Its ink height is 1.0248x. It sits 0.0024x above the cap line and 0.0224x below the baseline. The O overshoots by 0.013x at both ends. V5 states 0.02x above and below.

The ampersand's thick strokes reach 0.69 to 0.78 of the cap stems. Its thin strokes are 0.41 of the stems and half the cap bars. Thick to thin contrast is about 1.9 to 1 inside the ampersand against 1.22 to 1 in the letters, so the red glyph reads lighter than the black words beside it, and its hairlines are the first part to break up at small sizes.

4. Red edge contrast

Pillar Red measures 2.96:1 on Newsprint, 4.17:1 on White, 4.49:1 on Charcoal and 3.19:1 on Prussian at full coverage. At small sizes most red pixels are partly covered, so the ampersand's measured contrast falls below the nominal value. 5. Outlines clipped by their own viewBox

The cut shows wherever V5 uses #amp: the freestanding master, the hinge diagram, container marks above 16 px, watermarks and hinge headlines. L4, L5 and L6 use the tagline and URL symbols, and the 1440 tiles show the clipped descenders (03-identity-01.jpg: "countrv", "peoole", ".orq"). The stacked lockup clips 0.89 units off the ampersand's tail.

6. The 16 px ampersand

#amp-16 is the master outline with a 5.2-unit stroke in glyph space, which is 0.73 units in the symbol, inside a viewBox padded by 3 units on each side. At 16 px tall that adds 0.055 px per side, and the padding draws the glyph at 0.9437 of the master's size. Total ink at the same box height: amp 16px 112.4, amp 24px 251.3, amp-16 16px 103.9, amp-16 24px 234.5 (sum of pixel coverage). V5 says the 16 px drawing has a heavier contour so the counter stays open. A heavier contour closes counters; this one changes almost nothing. In the 16 px containers V5 sets it at 70 percent of the circle against 58 percent at other sizes, so the extra presence comes from scale.

7. Lockmark pixel fit

Links are 1 px with vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; nodes are 7.6 units across and the lever 9.5. The node and link stop reading as different things below about 32 px.

At 16, 24 and 48 px the middle link lands on a whole pixel, so it splits across two rows at half strength, while the outer links land near a pixel centre and draw close to solid. The grid draws with uneven line weight at every common size. Node diameter: 16 px: 0.98, 24 px: 1.48, 32 px: 1.97, 48 px: 2.95, 96 px: 5.91, 240 px: 14.77. Lever: 16 px: 1.23, 24 px: 1.85, 32 px: 2.46, 48 px: 3.69, 96 px: 7.38, 240 px: 18.46.
